dependencies.detail: Kindred is not defined in card text; for a spell it must match the spell school (Holy) of a card played last turn. ManaEngine's kindred_qualified checks minion types only, so it would never qualify this spell
dependencies.source_needed: official Kindred rule (minion type and spell school, which turn)

decisions.question: When is Kindred met for a Holy spell?
alternatives: a Holy spell was played on your previous turn
any card sharing a type or school was played last turn by either player
decisions.chosen: a Holy spell was played on your previous turn
decisions.discriminating_case: previous turn: Flash Heal (Holy) played; this card's cost in hand shows 2

decisions.question: Is the reduction live in hand (aura) or applied once?
decisions.discriminating_case: the card's cost tag in hand changes at the turn boundary
